title: HP and the art of AI and data for the enterprise
summary: HP's AI & Data Science Business Development Manager discusses enterprise AI implementation strategies, data processing for AI ingestion, and the comparison between local versus cloud computing infrastructure for AI workloads at an industry expo.
problem_solved: Helps enterprises understand AI deployment strategies and compute infrastructure decisions between local and cloud environments.
why_valuable: Provides practical insights from a major technology vendor on balancing AI data processing needs with appropriate compute infrastructure for enterprise environments.
